t: A browser coding platform with courses, auto-graded tests, quizzes, and AI grading.
steps: Find the JuiceMind website and sign up through the portal.
Assign one course such as Intro to AI.
Review the starter code and tests.
Ask IT to review the privacy terms before students join.
Check what AI Grading sends to the vendor.
Use the quiz tool for a first low stakes class check.
